PROMPT_DIRTRIM.description: Number of path components to keep when trimming the directory in the prompt.

PROMPT_COLOR.description: Default ANSI color code for the prompt text.

PROMPT_USERHOST.description: Prompt string component for user and hostname.

PROMPT_SEPARATOR.description: Separator character between user/host and directory in the default prompt style.

PROMPT_DIRECTORY.description: Prompt string component for the current working directory.

PROMPT_SEPARATOR_TRADITIONAL.description: Separator character for the traditional prompt style.

PROMPT_DIRECTORY_TRADITIONAL.description: Directory component for the traditional prompt style (basename only).

PROMPT_START_TRADITIONAL.description: Opening bracket for the traditional prompt style.

PROMPT_END_TRADITIONAL.description: Closing bracket for the traditional prompt style.
